title: Alarm clock with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bells -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="18" r="10" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="18" r="10" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Bell tops -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FFF176"/>
  <!-- Hammer between bells -->
  <rect x="47" y="10" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#FF8A65"/>
  <!-- Clock body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="32" fill="#4FC3F7" stroke="#29B6F6" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Clock face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="24" fill="#E1F5FE"/>
  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <rect x="49" y="33" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <rect x="49" y="72" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <rect x="27" y="54" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <rect x="68" y="54" width="5" height="2" rx="1" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- Clock hands -->
  <line x1="50" y1="55" x2="50" y2="38" stroke="#FF7043" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="55" x2="62" y2="62" stroke="#FF7043" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Center dot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#FF7043"/>
  <!-- Smiling face -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#1565C0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="2.5" fill="#1565C0"/>
  <path d="M 40 58 Q 50 68 60 58" fill="none" stroke="#1565C0" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="57" r="3" fill="#FFAB91" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="57" r="3" fill="#FFAB91" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x="32" y="85" width="8" height="8" rx="3" fill="#FF8A65"/>
  <rect x="60" y="85" width="8" height="8" rx="3" fill="#FF8A65"/>
</svg>
